reading.body:
This record is a single OpenStreetMap point in Poland tagged as a data center, with zero megawatts recorded and no confirmed operator.

The only substantive fact is the tag itself. The name Korbank matches a Polish IT company, which suggests an office running its own systems rather than a commercial colocation hall. The zero megawatt figure is consistent with that reading, but it is also consistent with a facility whose power draw was simply never recorded. Nothing here establishes which.

For AI specifically, this entry carries no weight. A site with no stated capacity, no operator, and no independent confirmation cannot be counted toward the power and building capacity that constrain model training and serving. Including it in a count of data centers would overstate the estate.

What the data does not cover is most of what matters: current ownership, whether the tag is accurate, whether any servers are present, and how much power the site draws. The research note states that re-confirmation failed because search quota ran out, so the identification is plausible rather than verified. Treat this as a candidate entry awaiting confirmation, not as a facility.
